name: Cloud Service and Security-Tool Discovery
description: Before they disable logging, attackers look around: which regions are on, whether GuardDuty exists, where CloudTrail writes, what the organization tree looks like. That reconnaissance is quiet and mostly read-only. It tells them where the cameras are so they can walk around them. A burst of Describe* and List* calls against security services from a new identity is casing the building, not doing ops.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
